name: openai/tunnel-client
title: openai/tunnel-client
headline: Secure tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI
lede: You can connect private or localhost MCP servers to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API and AgentKit without exposing them to the public internet.

effects.effect: Internal data and tools reachable by more agent surfaces
Private MCP servers become usable from hosted agent products
Less need to publish internal endpoints for agent access
